$Comment: Who the Oilers walk to and oil: the Heartwinder in its fight roles (the boss's own group, which leaves out the pendulums: the old role glob Machinaria_Heartworks_Heartwinder* also caught them, and an Oiler then walked to the nearer pendulum and oiled it; Gibson round 2 note 27), and the test stand-in Machinaria_Heartworks_Oiler_Dummy. A ? stands in for one letter of each role name: the server checks plain names before the mod's roles have loaded and warns about every one, while a pattern matching that one role alone is resolved once they have.
